question:
Select the word from the options which is similar in meaning to the bracketed part given in the sentence below.

The women stared at me with (great interest or concern).
solution:
The correct answer is "**curiosity**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word 'curiosity' means a strong desire to know or learn something.(जिज्ञासा)
 
 
• Example: Curiosity always prompts the questions in our mind.
 
 
 
• **It is similar in meaning to 'great interest or concern' mentioned in the sentence.**
 
• The sentence implies that the women were looking at the speaker with a lot of interest or curiosity.
 
• Therefore, the correct option is 'curiosity'.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 (intellect) means the ability to think and reason, but it does not match the meaning of the given phrase.(बुद्धि)
 
• Option 2 (control) means the power to influence or direct something, but it is not similar to the given phrase.(नियंत्रण)
 
• Option 4 (possession) means the state of having or owning something, which is not related to the given phrase.(कब्ज़ा)
